children: GameStop
may still be in the early stages of a much larger transformation, according to Yorkville Ives, which sees the retailer evolving into a leaner and more profitable collectibles platform.
Analyst Dan Ives reiterated an
Outperform
rating on GameStop with a
$32 price target
, arguing that 2027 could become an important inflection year.
The biggest change is happening in the company's sales mix.
Ives said collectibles are now approaching
half of GameStop's revenue
, giving the company a much different profile than the legacy video-game retailer investors once knew.
The key advantage, in his view, is infrastructure.
GameStop already has a nationwide store footprint, a long-standing trade-in culture, and a customer base accustomed to buying, selling and swapping products.
Its relationship with PSA adds another layer.
Participating GameStop stores can act as intake points for card grading and authentication, allowing collectors to access services that would otherwise typically require mailing items directly.
In effect, GameStop's stores are becoming a distributed intake and authentication network for a broader collectibles ecosystem, Ives wrote.
The analyst also highlighted GameStop's digital power packs business, arguing that the real opportunity may come from the transactions and higher-margin activity that follow the initial sale.
Investor Takeaway
I think the most interesting part of Ives' thesis is that he is not betting on GameStop simply becoming a better video-game retailer.
He is arguing that the company is building a
collectibles infrastructure network
That distinction matters because authentication, grading, trade-ins and resale can potentially create repeat activity and higher-margin economics around each customer relationship.
Ives also sees strategic value in GameStop's eBay
stake.
He believes there is logic in combining
eBay's marketplace liquidity with GameStop's physical stores, authentication capabilities and trade-in infrastructure
, whether through an eventual acquisition or commercial partnership.
For investors, the key things to watch are
collectibles mix, PSA transaction growth, margins, eBay-related developments and whether 2027 delivers the operating inflection Ives expects
GameStop shares reached a new
52-week high of $28.30 Thursday
, suggesting investors are increasingly willing to give the transformation thesis another look.

title: Dan Ives Sees Major New Chapter for Popular Meme Stock
